test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 14 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Five years ago, the average age of A, B and C was 17 years. Seven years ago, the average age of A and B was 17(1)/(2) years. What will be the age (in years) of C after 2 years from now?
solution:
Given:

Five years ago, the average age of A, B, and C was 17 years. 

Seven years ago, the average age of A and B was 17(1)/(2) years i.e. 17.5 years.

Calculation:

Let A, B, and C be P, Q, and R years old. (Presently)

According to the question,

**(P - 7) + (Q - 7) = 17.5 × 2**</
